name: Breakdown at San Felice Scalo
description: Valle Lauro line, ETCS with the reference onboard and the interlocking trackside, with the reference regulator. R 5101 breaks down in San Felice Scalo on track I while waiting for its departure, and stays still for 600 s; the controlled train arrives behind it on track II. Without a regulator route setting gives the exit to R 5101 at its timetabled time and the controlled train waits until the fault ends. The regulator lowers the priority of R 5101, moves its departure after the end of the fault and lets the controlled train leave first.
